title: MetaCLASS: Metacognitive Coaching for Learning with Adaptive Self-regulation Support

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model predictions on a Coach Move Prediction task to measure the discrepancy between the model's predicted frequency of active tutoring interventions and the ground-truth frequency of strategic restraint ('No Intervention'). The bias is quantified by subtracting the ground-truth percentage from the predicted percentage for each pedagogical move.
